candidates.tagline: €240M Rotterdam landmark winner looks like cartoon rocks on the riverbank
candidates.story: Dutch firm MVRDV won a €240M competition to build Rotterdam's next landmark with 'Rotterdam Rocks!' — seven stacked lumpy boulders on the Maas riverfront — and readers immediately called it 'a bad acid trip' and 'something Shrek would throw up.'
candidates.why_funny: An architectural rendering of what is objectively a pile of cartoon boulders, presented to the public as a serious world wonder.
candidates.alt: Architectural rendering of seven large stacked boulder-shaped structures rising from Rotterdam's riverbank, rendered as smooth rounded lumps

candidates.tagline: Qualcomm's AI robot faceplanted mid-keynote. Spokesman: 'Designed safe-collapse.'
candidates.story: A NEURA Robotics humanoid running Qualcomm's Dragonwing IQ10 chip pitched forward and collapsed face-down on stage mid-demo at Computex 2026 in Taipei; staff hastily covered it with a tarp and carried it off — dropping it on the way — while the presenter kept talking.
candidates.why_funny: A robot lying face-down on a polished conference stage under a tiny tarp, while a slide behind it reads 'FUTURE OF AI ROBOTICS.'
candidates.alt: A humanoid robot lying face-down on a keynote stage, being covered with a black tarp by conference staff while the presentation continues behind them
